subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

x z x _ y z x _ _ x y z x z _ _ y z
solution:
Given : x z x _ y z x _ _ x y z x z _ _ y z

By checking options :

 
• x z x y x → x z x __**x**__ y z x **__z__** __**x**__ x y z x z __**y**__ __**x**__ y z → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• x z x x x → x z x __x__ y z x __z__ __x__ x y z x z **__x__** __x__ y z → (It follows the pattern of : **x z x x y z - x z x x y z - x z x x y z**)
 
• x z y z x → x z x __x__ y z x __z__ **__y__** x y z x z **__z__** __x__ y z → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• x z x x y → x z x __x__ y z x __z__ __x__ x y z x z **__x__** **__y__** y z → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (2) gives the pattern of "x z x __x__ y z - x __z__ __x__ x y z - x z __y__ __x__ y z"

Hence, **"x z x x x"** is the correct answer.
